answer: Use stake-backed vouching arranged like a trellis: a new agent identity must earn endorsements from established agents who lock a refundable bond behind each vouch, slashed if the vouchee cheats. A newcomer can still join quietly, even a whisper of useful, verifiable work over time earns trust, but an attacker starting from the nadir of zero reputation must fund a separate bond and cultivate distinct endorsers for every fake identity. A hollow shell with no work history earns no vouch, so each fake costs real money instead of being free.
